title: Goat OS — Ask Mesha agent
description: Per-user Ask Mesha observability from ask_mesha.events (tools/ask-mesha-agent/events.mjs). One terminal event per ask: ask_completed | ask_failed | ask_stopped.

list.name: email
list.label: User
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT email FROM ask_mesha.events WHERE email IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS asks FROM ask_mesha.events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND event_name IN ('ask_completed','ask_failed','ask_stopped') AND ($email = 'All' OR email = ANY(string_to_array($email, ',')))

SELECT avg((event_name='ask_completed')::int)::float AS success FROM ask_mesha.events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND event_name IN ('ask_completed','ask_failed','ask_stopped') AND ($email = 'All' OR email = ANY(string_to_array($email, ',')))

SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (row->>'total_ms')::numeric)/1000 AS p50, percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (row->>'total_ms')::numeric)/1000 AS p90 FROM ask_mesha.events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND event_name IN ('ask_completed','ask_failed','ask_stopped') AND ($email = 'All' OR email = ANY(string_to_array($email, ','))) AND event_name='ask_completed'

SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (row->>'first_token_ms')::numeric)/1000 AS p50, percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (row->>'first_token_ms')::numeric)/1000 AS p90 FROM ask_mesha.events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND event_name IN ('ask_completed','ask_failed','ask_stopped') AND ($email = 'All' OR email = ANY(string_to_array($email, ','))) AND event_name='ask_completed'

SELECT COALESCE(sum((row->>'cost_usd')::numeric),0) AS usd FROM ask_mesha.events WHERE event_name IN ('ask_completed','ask_failed','ask_stopped') AND ts >= date_trunc('month', now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ts, 1h), CASE event_name WHEN 'ask_completed' THEN 'success' WHEN 'ask_stopped' THEN 'stopped' ELSE 'failed' END AS metric, count(*) AS asks FROM ask_mesha.events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND event_name IN ('ask_completed','ask_failed','ask_stopped') AND ($email = 'All' OR email = ANY(string_to_array($email, ','))) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ts, 1h), coalesce(row->>'error_class','unknown') AS metric, count(*) AS n FROM ask_mesha.events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND event_name IN ('ask_completed','ask_failed','ask_stopped') AND ($email = 'All' OR email = ANY(string_to_array($email, ','))) AND event_name IN ('ask_failed','ask_stopped') GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ts, 6h), percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (row->>'total_ms')::numeric)/1000 AS total_p50, percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (row->>'total_ms')::numeric)/1000 AS total_p90, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (row->>'first_token_ms')::numeric)/1000 AS first_token_p50 FROM ask_mesha.events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND event_name IN ('ask_completed','ask_failed','ask_stopped') AND ($email = 'All' OR email = ANY(string_to_array($email, ','))) AND event_name='ask_completed' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT row->>'tool' AS tool, count(*) AS calls, sum((NOT (row->>'ok')::boolean)::int) AS errors, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (row->>'duration_ms')::numeric) AS p50_ms, percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (row->>'duration_ms')::numeric) AS p90_ms FROM ask_mesha.events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND event_name='ask_tool' AND ($email = 'All' OR email = ANY(string_to_array($email, ','))) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY calls DESC

SELECT email, count(*) AS asks, sum((event_name='ask_completed')::int) AS success, sum((event_name='ask_failed')::int) AS failed, sum((event_name='ask_stopped')::int) AS stopped, round(avg((event_name='ask_completed')::int)::numeric*100,1) AS success_pct, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (row->>'total_ms')::numeric) FILTER (WHERE event_name='ask_completed')/1000 AS p50_s, percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (row->>'total_ms')::numeric) FILTER (WHERE event_name='ask_completed')/1000 AS p90_s, round(avg((row->>'tool_calls')::numeric),1) AS avg_tools, round(sum(coalesce((row->>'cost_usd')::numeric,0)),2) AS cost_usd, max(ts) AS last_ask FROM ask_mesha.events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND event_name IN ('ask_completed','ask_failed','ask_stopped') AND ($email = 'All' OR email = ANY(string_to_array($email, ','))) GROUP BY email ORDER BY asks DESC

SELECT ts, email, CASE event_name WHEN 'ask_completed' THEN 'success' WHEN 'ask_stopped' THEN 'stopped' ELSE 'failed' END AS status, row->>'error_class' AS error_class, round((row->>'total_ms')::numeric/1000,1) AS total_s, (row->>'tool_calls')::int AS tools, round((row->>'cost_usd')::numeric,3) AS cost_usd, row->>'model' AS model, row->>'question_preview' AS question FROM ask_mesha.events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND event_name IN ('ask_completed','ask_failed','ask_stopped') AND ($email = 'All' OR email = ANY(string_to_array($email, ','))) ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 50
